suggestions.title: No Country for Old Men
suggestions.description: A hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and a suitcase full of cash, drawing the attention of a relentlessly determined hitman. The Coen Brothers' Oscar-winning modern noir is a suspenseful, near-wordless cat-and-mouse chase across the Texan desert, anchored by Javier Bardem's chilling, iconic Anton Chigurh. A masterclass in tension and atmosphere.

suggestions.title: Das Boot
suggestions.description: The harrowing, claustrophobic life aboard a German U-boat during the Battle of the Atlantic in WWII. Wolfgang Petersen's epic is widely regarded as one of the greatest war films ever made, with breathtaking tension, superb production design, and an authentic, nerve-shredding depiction of life under the sea. A foreign-language classic that immerses you entirely.

suggestions.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
suggestions.description: A heartbroken Joel discovers his ex-girlfriend Clementine has had him erased from her memory, and undergoes the same procedure himself — only to relive their love as it's being deleted. Michel Gondry and Charlie Kaufman's poignant, inventive sci-fi romance is a deeply moving exploration of love, memory, and regret, with stunning turns from Jim Carrey and Kate Winslet.
